title: aria alnifolia f. lobulata
intro: Aria alnifolia f. lobulata, commonly known as White Alder, is a plant species within the Betulaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of White Alder are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The health benefits of White Alder include reducing fever, treating respiratory issues, and supporting immune function, making it a potential natural remedy for various ailments.
